routes.label: Read the logarithm as an exponent

question: If \(a\) and \(b\) are positive and \(a\ne1,\) \(b\ne1,\) then the value of \(b^{\log_b a}\) is:
solution:
The conditions \(a>0\), \(b>0\), and \(b\ne1\) ensure that \(\log_b a\) is defined. By definition, \(t=\log_b a\) means \(b^t=a\). Therefore
\[
b^{\log_b a}=a.
\]
The value depends only on \(a\), so the answer is B.
